jobs.title: AI Content Specialist
jobs.description: About Voodoo Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 8 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way. Team Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech. Today, our Creative team makes 10K+ ads a month, mostly by hand. We are rebuilding that process with AI to multiply both our output and our hit rate. The challenge is to produce at massive scale, with quality that holds up. Role As an AI Content Producer , you own the production of our ads (Playables, video ads, ASO visuals, statics) and build the AI workflows that let us ship them at scale. You think in systems: you don’t just make creatives, you build the pipelines that scale them. You will: Produce creatives with AI, end to end: turn briefs into finished ads for the games you cover, from first draft to launch. Design and implement AI workflows: build pipelines that automate variations and repetitive production steps, and roll them out so the whole team can ship more, faster. Own our AI toolbox: test and combine the best tools (Veo, Sora, Kling, Seedance, Runway, Scenario, etc.) and integrate the ones that matter into our production workflows. Learn from performance: analyze results (hook rate, CTR, CVR, IPM) and feed the learnings into the next batches and into the workflows themselves. jobs.title: Werkstudent LinkedIn Content & Copywriting (B2B) | remote möglich, 10–20 Std./Woche
jobs.description: Wer wir sind F& | FOCUS & FLOW ist ein Beratungs-Hub für Transformation und Prozessverbesserung. Wir arbeiten vor allem mit Unternehmen aus dem produzierenden Mittelstand: mit Geschäftsführer:innen und Führungsteams, die ihre Organisation wirksamer aufstellen wollen, ohne sich im Methoden-Dschungel zu verlieren. Daraus entwickeln wir Beratungsprodukte, Trainings und Workshops, vor Ort und virtuell. Unser Anspruch dabei ist, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Gemeinwohl zusammenzudenken. Unser Team ist klein, die Wege sind kurz. Wer bei uns mitarbeitet, sieht schnell, was die eigene Arbeit bewirkt. Aufgaben WAS DICH BEI UNS ERWARTET: Im Mittelpunkt steht die LinkedIn-Präsenz unseres Geschäftsführers. Er ist das Gesicht von FOCUS & FLOW und für viele unserer Kund:innen der erste Berührungspunkt mit uns. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Präsenz mit ihm gemeinsam aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln. Du schreibst LinkedIn-Beiträge in seiner Stimme. Dafür lernst du, wie er denkt, argumentiert und formuliert, und triffst seine Tonalität so, dass seine Beiträge nach ihm klingen und nicht nach Marketing. Du entwickelst mit ihm Themen und Formate, planst die Veröffentlichungen und hältst den Redaktionsplan am Laufen. Du baust sein Netzwerk strategisch aus: Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen aus dem Mittelstand, bereitest Vernetzungen vor und behältst im Blick, wer auf seine Inhalte reagiert. Interessante Kontakte übergibst du strukturiert an unser Pre-Sales-Team und stimmst dich eng mit den Kolleg:innen ab. So wird aus Reichweite echtes Geschäft. Du wertest aus, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab. Daneben unterstützt du bei der Unternehmensseite, erstellst Grafiken, Karussells und kurze Videos und arbeitest an Landingpages und Website-Inhalten mit, inklusive Optimierung für Suchmaschinen (SEO) und KI-gestützte Suchsysteme wie ChatGPT, Perplexity oder Google AI Overviews (GEO). jobs.title: Portugal Content Specialist
jobs.description: Role Overview We're looking for an ambitious, growth-obsessed Content Specialist who basically thinks in TikToks. Someone who gets fired up by great content, knows what's trending before it trends, and wants to take Bump to #1 on the App Store in Portugal (and keep it there). You'll be the person bringing internet culture from Portugal into the heart of our Paris office, creating content, leading creators, testing wild ideas, breaking things (in a good way), and helping us build Bump into a must-have app. If that sounds like your dream job, keep reading. You are: Ambitious, driven, and wildly creative. A natural storyteller who knows exactly why one video flops and another takes off. Someone who spends more time on TikTok than you'd ever admit publicly. Comfortable giving creators feedback that actually makes their content better. Deeply tuned into Portuguese memes, humour, and online culture. Fluent in Portuguese and English, and have lived in Portugal. Excited to work onsite in Paris, with a fast-moving team. Scrappy, energetic, experimental, you love trying 10 ideas to find the 1 that blows up, yet rigorous and detail oriented. What You'll Do: Grow Bump in Portugal (yep, you'll actually own this). Lead all content + creator efforts for the Portuguese market. Make high-performing TikToks, Reels, and UGC-style ads that people actually want to watch. Build and manage a pipeline of Portuguese creators. Run influencer campaigns with top Portuguese creators and micro-influencers. Work closely with paid marketing to turn great content into great performance. Jump on trends before they hit the For You Page. Write briefs, give notes, and help external creators shine. Collaborate daily in our Paris office with growth, distribution, and product. Join brainstorms, test ideas fast, and help shape the creative direction of Bump. Support launches, events, and Portugal-focused activations. Requirements: 1–5+ years making short-form content (brand, agency, influencer, or creator,
